text:
kevin: Hi all, I'm handing in my resignation today. Last day will be 2026-07-09. I'm based in India (Bengaluru). A couple of India-specific questions: how do gratuity and tax finalization work? Also visa sponsorship ends on my last day — need guidance on certificate of employment for immigration. cc @priya
priya (people-ops): Thanks for the heads-up, Kevin. Sorry to see you leave. Quick Q: will you be onsite for the handover week? That affects badge pickup scheduling.
sanjeev (manager): Kevin, we can host most KT remotely. Please keep 2026-07-08 and 07-09 free for knowledge transfer with the infra team.
kevin: I'll be onsite 07/08 for badge return and to sign paperwork. For gratuity  My employer contributions are eligible? Also any mandatory notice pay implications?
priya (people-ops): For IN payroll: gratuity is paid if tenure >=5 years normally, else not. But there are local company policies for severance/notice pay. We'll run final payroll with payroll ops and confirm amounts. Please complete the offboard form so payroll can compute final settlement.
kevin: Got it. I'll fill the form. What about tax certificate/Form 16 and PF/ESIC finalization?
priya (people-ops): Payroll will issue Form 16 for the FY as usual. PF/ESIC closure takes a couple weeks post-termination to complete with government portals. We'll provide the PF passbook export and guidance.
raja (it): On device and SIM return: we can schedule courier pickup or you can drop at office 07/08. We need to disable corporate SIM and reassign the number. Which do you prefer?
kevin: Drop at office 07/08 morning. Also I need email access for vendor payments until 07/15. No code pushes after 07/09.
raja (it): Standard deprovision plan: revoke admin/service tokens on 07/10, disable SSO on 07/16, disable email on 07/16. We'll keep Slack through 07/12 for handover. Badge deactivation on 07/08 EOD. I'll add exceptions for the extended email access.
priya (people-ops): Noted. Please confirm if you have any active service accounts or third-party credentials we need to rotate.
kevin: I have two non-prod service keys used for testing and one PagerDuty integration token. I'll list them in the offboard form.
sanjeev (manager): I'll take ownership of the service keys after Kevin lists them. Raja, please rotate keys and transfer ownership to me.
raja (it): Will do. Action plan snippet I'll run:
```
/offboard --user kevin --badge-off 2026-07-08 --slack-off 2026-07-12 --email-off 2026-07-16 --sso-off 2026-07-16
```
I'll comment on the ticket with key rotation IDs when complete.
offboard-bot: [OFF-2333] Offboarding ticket created for kevin. Next: people-ops to confirm final payroll timeline and legal to confirm any contractual post-termination obligations.
legal@redwood: Quick flag: Kevin, please confirm if your offer letter includes a post-termination IP assignment or garden-leave clause; we'll check non-compete/covenant terms and reply.
kevin: My offer mentions IP assignment and a 3-month non-solicit clause. No garden leave language that I recall.
priya (people-ops): Thanks. We'll ask legal to confirm if the non-solicit affects independent contracting with customers. Legal will reply in-thread.
legal@redwood: Confirmed. Non-solicit is standard and limited to direct solicitation of employees for 6 months in the region. It does not bar general freelance work but we'll send formal wording.
kevin: Thanks. One more: stock vesting  I have unvested options. Any special filing or accelerated exercise windows for IN hires?
priya (people-ops): Comp team will email you separately about your grant. Typical practice: post-termination exercise window depends on grant docs. We'll loop comp@ and include the grant schedule.
kevin: Appreciate it.
priya (people-ops): Please upload copies of any outstanding vendor invoices you own so finance can close them out before final pay. Also indicate whether you want the gratuity summary by email or in the offboard ticket.
kevin: Email preferred.
raja (it): Confirmed pickup slot 07/08 10:00AM for device + SIM. I'll create the pickup order and include prepaid label for any shipped accessories.
kevin: Thanks, Raja.
sanjeev (manager): Kevin, please add a 1-page handover doc with runbook links and who owns what. 15 minutes per service is fine.
kevin: Will add the handover doc tonight.
offboard-bot: [OFF-2333] People-ops approved initial offboard plan. Payroll scheduled to calculate final settlement after offboard form submission.
priya (people-ops): We'll send the certificate of employment for immigration once HR signs off. Expect documents within 3 business days post-signature.
kevin: Thank you everyone. Appreciate the help making this smooth.
priya (people-ops): Thanks, Kevin. We'll follow up in the ticket and email you required docs. :white_check_mark:
